attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: full_medical_document_processing_pipeline
steps:
  - id: authenticate_google_drive
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "service_account"
      provider: "google_drive"
    output: gdrive_auth

  - id: fetch_pdf_listing
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/google/drive/v3/files"
      query:
        mimeType: "application/pdf"
        folder: "medical_documents"
      auth: gdrive_auth
    output: raw_pdf_listing

  - id: validate_pdf_listing
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_pdf_listing
      schema: pdf_file_listing_schema
    output: validated_pdf_listing

  - id: read_processed_registry
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: processed_documents_registry
      query: "SELECT file_id, sha256_hash FROM processed_documents"
    output: raw_processed_registry

  - id: validate_processed_registry
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_processed_registry
      schema: processed_registry_schema
    output: validated_processed_registry

  - id: filter_new_documents
    op: filter_records
    params:
      input: validated_pdf_listing
      condition: "file_id NOT IN validated_processed_registry.file_ids"
    output: new_documents

  - id: loop_each_document
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: new_documents
      step: process_single_document
    output: processing_results

  - id: process_single_document
    op: call_subworkflow
    params:
      workflow_id: process_single_medical_document
      input_record: "current_item"
    output: raw_single_result

  - id: validate_single_result
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_single_result
      schema: single_document_result_schema
    output: validated_single_result

  - id: aggregate_batch_stats
    op: aggregate_data
    params:
      input: validated_single_result
      group_by: "batch"
      operations:
        - field: "documents_processed"
          function: "count"
        - field: "confidence_level"
          function: "distribution"
        - field: "errors"
          function: "count"
    output: batch_statistics

  - id: format_run_log
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: batch_statistics
      format: "json"
      template: "run_log_entry"
    output: formatted_run_log

  - id: log_pipeline_run
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: formatted_run_log
      event: "pipeline_run_complete"
      category: "medical_document_processing"
    output: audit_log_entry

  - id: authenticate_git
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "git_service_account"
      provider: "git_remote"
    output: git_auth

  - id: write_run_log_to_db
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: formatted_run_log
      table: pipeline_run_logs
    output: run_log_write_result

  - id: cleanup_notification
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: formatted_run_log
      recipient: "pipeline_admin"
      template: "pipeline_complete_summary"
    output: notification_result

  - id: terminate_pipeline
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "completed"
      summary: batch_statistics

---

workflow_id: process_single_medical_document
steps:
  - id: auth_drive_download
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "service_account"
      provider: "google_drive"
    output: download_auth

  - id: download_pdf
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/google/drive/v3/files/{file_id}?alt=media"
      method: "GET"
      auth: download_auth
      read_only: true
    output: raw_pdf_binary

  - id: extract_text_and_hash
    op: call_subworkflow
    params:
      workflow_id: pdf_text_extraction_with_ocr_fallback
      input_pdf: raw_pdf_binary
    output: raw_extraction_result

  - id: validate_extraction
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_extraction_result
      schema: extraction_result_schema
    output: validated_extraction

  - id: extract_text_content
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_extraction
      field: "extracted_text"
    output: clean_text

  - id: extract_sha256
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_extraction
      field: "sha256_hash"
    output: document_hash

  - id: anonymize_pii
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: clean_text
      mapping:
        doctor_names: "replace_with_token([DR_TOKEN_N])"
        hospital_names: "replace_with_token([HOSPITAL_TOKEN_N])"
        addresses: "replace_with_token([ADDRESS_TOKEN_N])"
        preserve: "clinical_values,lab_results,medications,dosages"
    output: anonymized_text

  - id: log_anonymization
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: anonymized_text
      event: "pii_anonymization_complete"
      document_hash: document_hash
    output: anonymization_audit

  - id: structure_markdown_primary
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: anonymized_text
      url: "https://ai-service.internal/structure-markdown"
      method: "POST"
      model: "primary"
    output: raw_markdown_primary

  - id: handle_primary_model_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      step: structure_markdown_primary
      on_error: structure_markdown_fallback
    output: primary_error_status

  - id: validate_markdown_primary
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_markdown_primary
      schema: markdown_output_schema
    output: validated_markdown

  - id: route_on_primary_failure
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "primary_error_status.has_error == true"
      true_step: structure_markdown_fallback
      false_step: verify_content_integrity
    output: routing_decision

  - id: structure_markdown_fallback
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: anonymized_text
      url: "https://ai-service.internal/structure-markdown"
      method: "POST"
      model: "fallback"
    output: raw_markdown_fallback

  - id: retry_fallback
    op: retry_step
    params:
      step: structure_markdown_fallback
      max_retries: 2
      backoff: "exponential"
    output: fallback_retry_result

  - id: validate_markdown_fallback
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_markdown_fallback
      schema: markdown_output_schema
    output: validated_markdown_fallback

  - id: verify_content_integrity
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "all_numbers_and_dates_preserved"
      source: anonymized_text
      target: validated_markdown
      checks:
        - "all numeric values in source exist in target"
        - "all date values in source exist in target"
        - "no clinical values altered"
    output: verification_result

  - id: extract_confidence
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: verification_result
      field: "confidence_level"
    output: confidence_level

  - id: log_verification
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: verification_result
      event: "content_verification_complete"
      document_hash: document_hash
      confidence: confidence_level
    output: verification_audit

  - id: route_on_confidence
    op: route_to
